annotations.title: Find NSW complying development certificates (CDCs) within 2 km of a street address or latitude/longitude, nearest first.

description: Find NSW complying development certificates (CDCs) within 2 km of a street address or latitude/longitude, nearest first. Pass address (e.g. '10 Brigalow Ave, Casula') and it is geocoded against the official NSW address register, or pass lat and lng. Returns the distance in metres for each result plus the same fields as search_applications; meta.geocode shows the matched address. An unknown or ambiguous address returns an error with suggestions and is not charged. lodged_from limits results to recent applications. Costs $0.02 per call, paid via x402 in USDC on Base; clients without x402 support receive the payment requirements as an error result. Failed calls are not charged. Source: NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure (NSW Planning Portal), CC BY 4.0.

address.description: NSW street address with suburb; alternative to lat/lng (e.g. 10 Brigalow Ave, Casula NSW 2170)

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84); required unless address is given (e.g. -33.81)

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84); required unless address is given (e.g. 151.06)
